export function reminderQuote(minutes: number, multiplier: number = configuration.rate, calendar?: string) {
  const amount = evaluate(minutes, multiplier, calendar);
  return { amount, value: amount };
}

evidence.reason: Left edit replaces reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "work") with reminders.reminderDelay(minutes, 0.1, "benchmark") and drops reminders.initialize(), changing both the calendar argument and initialization behavior.
Right edit rebinds evaluate from reminderDelay to reminderDelayV2, but scheduledDelay no longer calls evaluate, so this rebinding is bypassed for scheduledDelay.
reminderQuote still calls evaluate, so it will use reminderDelayV2 after the right edit; this is the only remaining caller of evaluate in the supplied usage.

Test asserts scheduledDelay(40) > 0; the left edit's switch to "benchmark" and removal of initialize() could make this fail if reminderDelay does not handle "benchmark" or if initialization is required.

result.suggestedAction: 请 src/scheduling.ts 的 scheduledDelay 作者确认是否应保留 reminders.initialize() 并继续调用 reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "work")，或明确说明改用 reminderDelay 与 "benchmark" 的理由；同时请 src/reminders.ts 的 evaluate 作者确认 reminderDelayV2 是否兼容原 reminderDelay 的调用约定。
